headline: The Gígur Visitor Center in Iceland / SP(R)INT STUDIO + Nissen Richards Studio
context: SP(R)INT STUDIO, together with London-based design partner Nissen Richards Studio, has created the permanent exhibition, interior, and graphic design for Gígur Visitor Centre in North Iceland, along with the center's welcome area, café, and shop.
